result_text:
I changed the two mock-folder rules in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/TestConventions.java` (lines 75–76). I didn't add test cases for `mock`, `mock.data`, `mock(old)`, `mock-größe` or `mock模拟`, nor for the files that must stay production. The existing `*Convention*` tests in `codeanalyzer` passed.

- **Before:** `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\\- ]+/.*` and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\\- ]+/.*`. These needed at least one extra ASCII letter, digit, `_`, `-` or space after `mock`, which is why plain `mock/`, `mock.data/`, `mock(old)/` and `mock-größe/` slipped through.
- **After:** `.*/__mock[^/]*/.*` and `.*/mock[^/]*/.*`. The rest of the folder name can now be anything, including nothing, so the elasticsearch `inference/mock/` folder is caught.

The match stays inside one folder name. `remock/` and `demo/` don't match because `mock` must follow a `/`. `src/main/java/` doesn't match because it has no `mock` folder. A file named `mock.java` or `mockery.java` doesn't match because the pattern needs a `/` after the folder name.

Backslash paths work without a separate rule. `SourceFileFilter.pathMatches` already tries the path with `\` converted to `/`. The old names (`mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/`, `mockStore/`) all still match the new pattern.
